## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant scripts/tests were run, or explain why they were not.
- [ ] Any CSV added is aggregate and does not contain one row per decedent.
- [ ] No restricted data, identifiers, model artifacts, credentials, or local environment files are included.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Results and claims are accurately represented.
- [ ] The branch is intended to merge into `develop` (or `main` only for a release from `develop`).
